title: Fade Banshee
html:
Shadow Fade Crooner

Fade Banshees are a special breed of Fade casters. Their attacks have a chance to induce the Curse of the Banshee on their victims, which causes the victim to run uncontrollably in fear. The effect disappears after a few seconds, or if the Banshee which casted the spell is killed. A cursed opponent will gain Bravery which gives immunity to fear for 6 times the length of time that fear lasted.

Race: Fade

Class: Mage

Tip: These guys are a pain in the rear to defeat, with their spell-casting and curses. They have a high movement speed which can have a fighter running them down to defeat them.

Basic Types
